text: Walking through this modern space, I feel a strange combination of anticipation and curiosity. The sleek glass and bright screens signal a place filled with purpose and the promise of discovery. Entering the colorful, vibrant R+D exhibit, my sense of wonder intensifies. The talk of research and innovation opens my mind to possibility—what does it mean to be human, to coexist with intelligence, to constantly adapt and evolve? I feel small amidst these big questions, yet also invigorated by the pursuit of knowledge on display all around me.
